title: market-signal label (one line of runs/<YYYYMMDD>/labels.jsonl)
description: Written by the model after reading every record of the corpus (skills/coding-the-corpus). One line per record read, relevant or not. compute_signals.py counts from these lines; the model never writes a count.

speaker.description: user: first person about their own situation. practitioner: first-hand advice from someone who did it (founder, investor, operator). vendor: promotes their own product or service. press: reports someone else's words. other: anything else.
